# Gate config manifest: the file SET whose content is folded into config_hash (RFC §13.1:
# "config_hash == hash of the config the review ran under"; a stale-config attestation is a miss).
# Same format and hash as senoff/xlsx-for-ai-server: scripts/gate_config_hash.py sha256s each
# listed file's content in byte-sorted path order. One repo-relative path per line; blank lines and
# '#' comments ignored. Every listed file must exist (the hash fails closed on a missing one).
#
# The manifest lists ITSELF, so adding or removing a protected file changes config_hash too.
#
# Every script the signer executes is listed, so a change to signer behavior also changes config_hash.
#
# Changing any file below invalidates every attestation minted under the old config, which forces
# a fresh review of the release PR under the new config. The signer reads this from main when it
# signs; the publish gate reads it from the release PR's base ref when it verifies.
.github/review-gate/config-manifest.txt
.github/review-gate/signer-allowlist.json
.github/workflows/review-gate.yml
.github/workflows/publish.yml
scripts/publish-attestation-gate.sh
scripts/review_attest_sign.py
scripts/review_gate_precondition.py
scripts/review_gate_marker_present.py
scripts/gh_retry.sh
scripts/content_id.py
scripts/gate_config_hash.py
